news.contents: Las Vegas Raiders wide receiver Tre Tucker was held without a single catch in Week 8, which is a concern given how productive he had been in previous weeks. Tucker was particularly dominant in Weeks 6-7, when he combined for 10 catches, 197 yards, and three touchdowns, but he was even a solid WR3/flex earlier in the season. news.analysis: The veteran was limited for the team's first practice of the week on Wednesday. He's still managing an ankle issue of some kind, but it isn't likely to leave him sidelined in Week 9. He will continue to be a decently safe PPR option on a week-to-week basis moving forward.

news.contents: Kansas City Chiefs tight end Travis Kelce was listed on the injury report with an ankle injury he's been nursing for a couple of weeks, but he practiced in full and has no designation for the contest. The veteran tight end caught five of his seven targets for 67 yards in last week's loss to the Denver Broncos. news.analysis: The Aiyuk saga continues around San Francisco. The veteran wide receiver has been on the left squad list since the summer, but the 49ers will now have to make a decision to keep, cut, or, if possible, trade him. Aiyuk has not played in an NFL game since 2024.
news.contents: Brandon Aiyuk has filed for reinstatement and is prepared to rejoin the 49ers on Friday.
news.title: Brandon Aiyuk files for reinstatement with the NFL

news.contents: San Francisco 49ers wide receiver Brandon Aiyuk (knee) reportedly had his meeting with the organization on Friday. Aiyuk is feeling great and is 100 percent healthy after missing all of last season due to a torn ACL. The 28-year-old is attempting to get reinstated, but it's a bit of a complicated issue. news.title: Brandon Aiyuk is Not Reinstated on Transaction Report
